title: Rocky Mountain National Park Trip Planner Printable, Timed Entry Guide, 1 2 3 Day Itinerary, Best Day Hikes, Colorado PDF, Packing List
description:
Planning a first trip to Rocky Mountain National Park? This 30-page printable guide puts the whole trip on paper: how timed entry works, when to go, which hikes fit the altitude and your group, and how to spend 1, 2 or 3 days.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- The park at a glance: east side vs west side, the entrances, Estes Park and Grand Lake, and the elevations that matter
- When to go, month by month: snow on trails, wildflowers, golden aspens, the elk rut and road openings
- Timed entry explained step by step: the two reservation types, how the monthly and night-before releases worked in 2026, and what to do if you miss out
- The free park shuttles, gateway towns, campgrounds and 2026 entrance fees
- Altitude: why the first day feels hard and the warning signs to turn back
- Afternoon thunderstorms, and wildlife distances for elk, moose and bears
- 18 day hikes and walks on Bear Lake Road, in Wild Basin, near Longs Peak and on the quiet west side, with distance in mi and km and climb in ft and m, from nps.gov
- Trail Ridge Road and Old Fall River Road
- Sample 1, 2 and 3-day plans, rainy-day ideas, fall and winter visits, kids and families, accessible trails
- Packing list, booking checklist with dates to remember, a trip planner page and hike log pages

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Checked against nps.gov in November 2026. Timed entry dates, road openings, shuttles and fees change every year, so check nps.gov/romo for the coming season before you book. No maps or GPS files. The altitude page is general information, not medical advice. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
